required_findings.statement: The two outgoing transfers total USD 35,500.00 and use the same payee account.
The payee account differs from the documented approved account with no authorized change recorded.
Both payments were recorded after a documented instruction requiring senior review for that account.

material_unresolved_questions: Establish why the two recorded transfers proceeded despite the internal review instruction.
reference_rationale: The supplied fictional policy mandates referral for two or more post-notice outgoing payments to a specifically non-approved supplier account. This is not proof of fraud.
